summary: Participants discuss monitoring, increasing parallelism, handling large PRs, and suggest improvements such as cleaner invocation via GitHub UI and more concise review comments. A community discussion proposes extending Spark’s Real-Time Mode to eligible distributed batch SQL and DataFrame queries, enabling pipelined shuffle to overlap producer, transfer, and consumer stages and reduce per-query latency. It addresses prior review comments by tightening enforcement, preventing leaks in metadata and plan output, and ensuring older Spark releases fail closed via enforcesReadPolicies(). The proposal introduces a method to join streaming data with external storage by performing on-demand lookups instead of loading the entire static side.
